description: Solve a pipe network (Todini global gradient). Wire a Graph node into the main input (unconnected = whole canvas graph) and a Schema node into the Schema input to define node/segment properties; edit them per component in the Properties tab; per-component results appear in the Metrics tab.
instructions:
Solves a pipe network with the Todini global-gradient method. Wire a Graph node into the MAIN input (unconnected → the whole canvas segment graph). Wire a Schema node into the `gin-schema` input: its Node/Segment sections define the per-component input properties (demand, elevation, diameter…) by role, shown in each component's Properties tab; results (discharge, head, velocity, pressure…) land in each component's Metrics tab.

`formula` = Hazen-Williams or Darcy-Weisbach; `maxIter` / `tolerance` bound the solve. Publishes `val-totalDemand` / `val-maxVelocity` / `val-minPressure` / `val-iterations`.
